classificationRule: This exact-set ledger covers every Knowledge Bank claim whose internal claim or active or held projection identifies Jamie as actor, account subject, participant, or role holder. Source-corroborated means the named action is supported by a contemporaneous artifact or an independent attribution; first-person means Jamie is the only role source; mixed means first-person role evidence is paired with project-context or technical-trace evidence; open means the available evidence does not yet support an active individual-role projection. The parallel proofRecords ledger covers every proof claim permitted on a public surface.
